mechanism: Aspirin inhibits renal potassium excretion and may reduce glomerular filtration rate, increasing serum potassium levels, particularly in patients with renal impairment or those taking ACE inhibitors/ARBs.
action: Monitor serum potassium levels periodically in patients on chronic aspirin therapy, especially those with renal disease or concurrent medications that increase potassium; adjust potassium supplementation as needed.
